origin.source: Real Braintrust SDK over the unmodified email-drafter machine, scoring output, XState transitions, and usage

comparison.purpose: Evals observe typed output, transition trajectories, named request calls, and usage while a simulated user drives ordinary idle states; the prompt-completeness check is a Jev judgment the eval scripts or runs live beside the text seams.
comparison.requires: OPENAI_API_KEY to run the text model and TYPESAFE_API_KEY for the Jev judgment; a Braintrust account (BRAINTRUST_API_KEY) only to upload the experiment, since the eval itself runs locally without one.
